version.description: Semver, informational. The plugin's own release.

minProtocol.description: Minimum core plugin-protocol this plugin needs, as a semver requirement. Bare version = caret ("1.0.0" -> ^1.0.0); ranges allowed (">=1.2, <3"). Absent = no constraint (baseline). The host refuses to run a plugin it can't satisfy. Distinct from `version` (the plugin's own release).

exec.description: Executable for the event-reaction role. Relative paths resolve against the plugin dir; bare names resolve on PATH.

subscribes.description: Bus events forwarded to exec's stdin. ["*"] = all.

config.description: User-supplied settings, rendered as a form in the app. Each field's `key` is referenced by `webhooks` (urlFrom/secretFrom) and injected as an env var into any `exec`.

webhooks.description: Webhook transport handled by the server core. Outbound POSTs on bus events; inbound exposes a signed HTTP route. Service specifics are declared here, not coded.

key.description: Identifier; referenced by webhooks and injected as an env var name into exec.

type.description: `secret` values are stored in the OS keychain, never in settings.json or logs.

direction.description: `out` = core POSTs on matching bus events. `in` = core exposes a signed HTTP route.

urlFrom.description: out only — config key whose value is the destination URL.

events.description: out only — card statuses / bus event names that fire this webhook.

action.description: in only — rpc command to dispatch with the mapped payload (e.g. create_card).

map.description: in only — { rpcField: JSONPath } extracted from the inbound body.

exec.description: Optional escape hatch. Core invokes it request/response (raw request JSON on stdin → transformed payload / verify verdict on stdout) when named schemes/mapping don't fit.

scheme.description: Named signature scheme implemented in the core.

header.description: Request header carrying the signature (e.g. X-Hub-Signature-256).

secretFrom.description: Config key whose value is the shared signing secret.
